deployment_threshold_note: User accepted joint calibration on2026-10-26:alpha.972,gate35,action.925,object.581; false-positive priority with measured recall losses. See reports/four-parameter-tuning-20261026. Object prior now connected to the production per-person pipeline; runtime verification in reports/person-object-release-20261026. User explicitly adopted wave3 and running.35 priors on2026-10-27; integrated release verification: reports/full-prior-release-20261027. Original six models unchanged.

object_prior.policy: one compatible detection in any of five same-person 720-enhanced sampled frames; drink=[bottle,cup], pick_up=[bottle,cup,phone,camera,paper,portable_object]; low/unknown raw luma and unavailable/ambiguous observations abstain

wave_prior.policy: Same wrist above both shoulders on at least three unique source frames within existing one-second window; no continuity requirement; low/unknown raw luma and disabled skeleton bypass; bright insufficient pose rejects.

running_prior.policy: Mean displacement speed of common reliable joints over about .2s pairs in the existing one-second window; min5 joints/min3 pairs/span.3s; no coordinate smoothing; low/unknown raw luma, disabled skeleton or insufficient reliable speed bypass.
